description: Gitignore generator — Build a ready-to-commit .gitignore from GitHub's official github/gitignore templates (316 languages, frameworks, editors and OSes; CC0). templates= comma list, case-insensitive with aliases (node, python, go, rust, java, macos, windows, vscode, jetbrains, terraform, unity, nextjs, c#...). Merges and de-duplicates patterns across templates (dedupe=0 to keep all), extra= adds your own comma-separated patterns, list=1 lists every template name. Unknown names return spelling suggestions. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dev_gitignore
